title: Trie Autocomplete
description:
Implement a `Trie` class for efficient prefix-based word lookup.

- `insert(word)` — inserts a word into the trie
- `search(word)` — returns `true` if the exact word was inserted, `false` otherwise
- `startsWith(prefix)` — returns an array of all inserted words that start with `prefix` (any order)

**Example:**
```js
const trie = new Trie();
trie.insert('apple');
trie.insert('app');
trie.insert('apply');
trie.search('app');        // true
trie.search('ap');         // false
trie.startsWith('app');    // ['app', 'apple', 'apply'] (any order)
trie.startsWith('apz');    // []
```
ai_context: Common mistake: `search` returning true for a prefix that was never inserted as a complete word — forgetting to check `isEnd`. Also, learners often skip the DFS for `startsWith` and only return the prefix itself.
